metric_notes.query_time: Arithmetic mean of 24 EXPLAIN Execution Time values, milliseconds per query; excludes warm-up, initialization, DDL and model wall time.
metric_notes.cost_adjusted: Policy-aligned query mean plus risk-adjusted tuning DDL amortized over the configured prediction horizon; raw query and DDL components remain separate.
metric_notes.buffers: Mean root Plan Shared Hit/Read Blocks per query; child nodes are not summed.
metric_notes.tokens: Each token field is N/A if any called response lacks that field; known_token_subtotal is separately disclosed.
metric_notes.attempts: CREATE/DROP attempts count final CREATE/DROP requests (execution.attempted), including preexecution rejections. Submitted DDL (executed) and successes are separate.
metric_notes.reset_cost: Condition-reset DDL is separate from tuning actions/costs.
